Context: direct-mode --file/--graph must reject --allow-empty-description (narrow guards only; broader flag-hoist is PR 4918's separate scope); three new tests incl. a success round-trip.

Inspect the maintainer fix commit in worktree .worktrees/beads/pr-4984-fix:
  git -C .worktrees/beads/pr-4984-fix log --oneline -3
  git -C .worktrees/beads/pr-4984-fix diff HEAD~1..HEAD
plus surrounding source as needed. Read-only; post nothing; no bd/dolt commands.

Assess: (1) correctness and CI-breakage risk; (2) test honesty — would the new tests fail if the fix were reverted, and did they demonstrably run (beware -run patterns that match nothing); (3) scope fit vs the review items claimed. First line exactly 'VERDICT: SHIP' or 'VERDICT: FIX', then terse file:line bullets.

I’ll review only the specified worktree and commit, with no tracker or upstream actions. I’m using the repository’s reviewer-tier guidance for this cross-vendor gate, and will verify both the guard logic and that the targeted tests truly execute.
